notes.title: Yokai Survivor Steam Page Online!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The Ninja Town spin-off game [i]Yokai Survivor [/i]store page is now online!

We're looking to launch Early Access at the end of this month.

[i]Yokai Survivor is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter. Face relentless waves of twisted yokai in a cursed underworld, harvest precious fruits, and master powerful ninjutsu skills to turn the tide. It's one ninja against the underworld![/i]

Head on over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514690/Yokai_Survivor/]Yokai Survivor store page[/url] and take a look and wishlist the game if it looks like your type of game, thanks!
